tests.title: A [sandbox] section without the four gateway keys validates with the default listen, and the keys are known and expanded
given: a valid sandbox config with no listen, tls_cert, tls_key or external_url
an env var GWHOST=127.0.0.1
tests.when: the config is loaded and validated; then loaded again with listen="${GWHOST}:0" and with both an invalid listen and an invalid profile
then: the first validates with listen "127.0.0.1:8443"
none of the four keys is reported as unknown
the expanded listen is "127.0.0.1:0"
the third returns one joined error naming both sandbox.listen and the profile failure
tests.pseudocode: v,err = Validate(LoadConfig(p)); assert err==nil && v.Listen=="127.0.0.1:8443"; _,err = Validate(badBoth); assert contains(err,'sandbox.listen') && contains(err,'profiles')

tests.title: Invalid listen addresses are refused naming sandbox.listen, and ports 0 and 65535 are accepted
given: a valid base sandbox config
then: the first three return an error containing "sandbox.listen"
the last two validate without error
tests.pseudocode: for a in bad: assert contains(Validate(cfg(a)).err,'sandbox.listen'); for a in good: assert err==nil

tests.title: Loopback classification uses only localhost and literal loopback IPs
given: the loopback classifier with no DNS access
then: the first four are loopback
the remaining five are not loopback
tests.pseudocode: for a in loop: assert isLoopback(a); for a in nonloop: assert !isLoopback(a)

tests.title: Setting only one of tls_cert and tls_key names the missing key
given: a valid loopback sandbox config
tests.when: Validate runs with only tls_cert set, then with only tls_key set
then: the first error contains "sandbox.tls_key"
the second error contains "sandbox.tls_cert"
tests.pseudocode: assert contains(Validate(certOnly).err,'sandbox.tls_key'); assert contains(Validate(keyOnly).err,'sandbox.tls_cert')

tests.title: A non-loopback listen without TLS is refused with a loopback message
given: a sandbox config with listen "0.0.0.0:8443", an external_url, and no TLS
tests.when: Validate runs
then: the error contains "sandbox.listen" and "loopback"
tests.pseudocode: err=Validate(cfg).err; assert contains(err,'sandbox.listen') && contains(err,'loopback')

tests.title: A non-loopback listen without external_url is refused
given: a sandbox config with listen "0.0.0.0:8443" and TLS cert and key set, no external_url
tests.when: Validate runs
then: the error contains "sandbox.external_url"
tests.pseudocode: assert contains(Validate(cfg).err,'sandbox.external_url')

tests.title: Malformed external_url values are refused and a plain https URL with a root path validates
given: a valid base sandbox config
tests.when: Validate runs with external_url "gw.example.com", "ftp://gw", "https://u:p@gw", "https://gw?x=1", "https://gw#f", "https://gw/api" and "https://gw.example.com/"
then: the first six return an error containing "sandbox.external_url"
the last validates
tests.pseudocode: for u in bad: assert contains(Validate(cfg(u)).err,'sandbox.external_url'); assert Validate(cfg('https://gw.example.com/')).err==nil

tests.title: An unloadable TLS key pair refuses start with both field names and the loader error
given: statically valid config whose tls_cert and tls_key point at mismatched or garbage PEM files
tests.when: the startup function loads the key pair
then: it returns an error containing "sandbox.tls_cert", "sandbox.tls_key" and the tls.LoadX509KeyPair error text
the af-hub main treats the error as fatal (non-zero exit)
no listener is bound
tests.pseudocode: _,err = StartGateway(cfg); want=tls.LoadX509KeyPair(c,k); assert contains(err,'sandbox.tls_cert') && contains(err,'sandbox.tls_key') && contains(err, want.Error())

tests.title: Startup binds the listener, builds gatewayd with hub's settings, and a Dial client connects
given: a Service with network_modes, max_sandboxes, max_ttl and a recording provider
listen 127.0.0.1:0, no TLS
a seam capturing the gatewayd.Config passed to gatewayd.New
tests.when: the gateway start function runs and a gateway.Dial client connects to the bound address before any HTTP request is served
then: Config.Backend is hub's wrapping backend
Config.Authenticate is non-nil and Config.Tokens is empty
Config.TLS is nil, NetworkModes, MaxSandboxes and MaxTTL equal the validated values
the client connects successfully
tests.pseudocode: gw = StartGateway(cfg, captureNew); assert cap.Authenticate!=nil && len(cap.Tokens)==0; c = Dial(gw.URL, Options{Token:tok}); assert c.List(ctx) ok

tests.title: A bind failure refuses start naming sandbox.listen
given: a TCP listener already bound to a port
tests.when: the gateway start function runs with listen set to that same address
then: it returns an error containing "sandbox.listen" and the bind error text
main treats it as fatal (non-zero exit)
tests.pseudocode: _,err = StartGateway(cfgSameAddr); assert contains(err,'sandbox.listen') && contains(err, bindErr)

tests.title: A gatewayd.New error refuses start and closes the bound listener
given: a gatewayd constructor seam that returns an error
tests.when: the gateway start function runs on 127.0.0.1:0
then: the returned error wraps the gatewayd.New error (errors.Is)
the bound port can be re-bound immediately (listener closed)
tests.pseudocode: _,err = StartGateway(cfg, failingNew); assert errors.Is(err, sentinel); assert net.Listen(addr) ok

tests.title: An unexpected Serve return is logged and triggers a non-zero exit
given: a gateway whose Serve returns an error immediately
an injected exit function and captured slog output
tests.when: the serve goroutine runs
then: exactly one slog error record carries the Serve error
the exit function is called with a non-zero code
tests.pseudocode: run(serveFn=returns(errX), exit=rec); assert rec.code!=0 && logs.count(ERROR, errX)==1

tests.title: With the feature off no listener is bound and no gatewayd.Server is built
given: a nil sandbox Service
a gatewayd constructor seam counting calls
tests.when: the startup path runs
then: it succeeds
the constructor call count is 0
the configured listen port is not accepting connections
tests.pseudocode: gw,err = StartGateway(nil,...); assert err==nil && newCalls==0 && dial(addr) refused

tests.title: gateway_url is external_url, or scheme plus the bound address
given: listeners on 127.0.0.1:0
tests.when: the gateway URL is computed for no TLS, TLS, and external_url "https://gw.example.com"
then: no TLS gives "http://127.0.0.1:<bound port>" with port non-zero
TLS gives an https:// URL with the bound address
external_url gives exactly "https://gw.example.com"
tests.pseudocode: assert url(noTLS)=='http://'+l.Addr(); assert url(tls).startsWith('https://'); assert url(ext)==ext

tests.title: POST, GET one, workspace list and admin list all carry gateway_url on leases in every state
given: lease routes registered with a real SQLite lease store and a known gateway URL
leases in leased, active, destroyed and failed states
tests.when: each of the four endpoints is called with suitable credentials
then: every lease in every response has a gateway_url string equal to the configured value
tests.pseudocode: for ep in [post,getOne,wsList,adminList]: for l in leases(ep): assert l.gateway_url==want

tests.title: The authenticator accepts the token of a live unexpired lease and returns the lease id
given: a leased lease and an active lease with expires_at in the future by the injected clock
tests.when: the authenticator is called with each lease's token
then: it returns (lease id, true) in both cases
tests.pseudocode: id,ok = auth(ctx,tokL); assert ok && id==leaseL.ID

tests.title: The authenticator refuses empty, unknown, terminal and expired tokens
given: leases in destroyed, expired and failed states, one leased lease with expires_at equal to now, one past now
tests.when: the authenticator is called with "", "garbage", an unknown sbl_ token and each of those leases' tokens
then: every call returns ("", false)
tests.pseudocode: for t in tokens: id,ok=auth(ctx,t); assert id==''&&!ok

tests.title: Over real gRPC, revoked or unknown tokens get Unauthenticated on the very next RPC including relayed calls
given: an in-process gatewayd.Server on 127.0.0.1:0 with hub's authenticator and a recording provider
an active lease with a live box
tests.when: a gateway.Dial client with an unknown token calls Create; then the lease is moved to destroyed and the client of the original token calls List, Create and a relayed Agent RPC
then: the unknown token gets gRPC Unauthenticated
all three RPCs on the revoked token get Unauthenticated
a failed lease likewise yields Unauthenticated on the next RPC
tests.pseudocode: assert code(Dial(bad).Create())==Unauthenticated; store.Destroy(id); for rpc in [List,Create,Exec]: assert code(rpc)==Unauthenticated

tests.title: Store errors refuse the token and no log contains the token or its hash
given: captured slog output
a lease store that returns a non-not-found error for one lookup
tests.when: the authenticator is called with accepted tokens, refused tokens and the erroring lookup
then: the erroring lookup returns ("", false)
an error record is logged for it
captured logs contain neither any presented token nor its SHA-256 hex
tests.pseudocode: id,ok=auth(errTok); assert !ok; for t in toks: assert !contains(logs,t) && !contains(logs,sha256hex(t))

tests.title: Create without a principal fails before loading a lease or calling the provider
given: an injected principal function that reports none
a recording provider and lease-load counter
tests.when: backend.Create is called
then: a non-nil error is returned
provider Create count is 0
no lease was loaded
tests.pseudocode: _,err=b.Create(ctx,Spec{}); assert err!=nil && prov.creates==0 && store.loads==0

tests.title: A concurrent Create for the same lease gets FailedPrecondition and claims are released
given: a provider whose Create blocks until released
a leased lease
tests.when: a first Create is started, a second Create is issued while it blocks, then the first is released
then: the second returns FailedPrecondition without calling the provider
after the first returns the claim set does not contain the lease id
a claim is also released after a failing Create
tests.pseudocode: go b.Create(); wait(blocked); _,err=b.Create(); assert code(err)==FailedPrecondition && prov.creates==1; release(); assert !claims.has(id)

tests.title: Create on a non-leased lease names the state and changes nothing
given: an active lease
tests.when: Create is called with its principal
then: FailedPrecondition whose message contains "active"
the lease row is unchanged
provider Create count is 0
tests.pseudocode: err=Create; assert code==FailedPrecondition && contains(msg,'active') && lease==before

tests.title: Create on an expired leased lease is refused without a state change
given: a leased lease whose expires_at equals the injected now
tests.when: Create is called
then: FailedPrecondition whose message contains "expired"
the lease still reads leased
provider Create count is 0
tests.pseudocode: assert code(err)==FailedPrecondition && contains(msg,'expired') && state=='leased' && prov.creates==0

tests.title: A lease whose profile is no longer configured fails with a message naming the profile
given: a leased lease with profile "gone" absent from the in-memory profiles
a recording emitter
tests.when: Create is called
then: FailedPrecondition whose message names "gone"
the lease reads failed with the same error
exactly one hub.sandbox.failed event is recorded
tests.pseudocode: assert code==FailedPrecondition && lease.state=='failed' && lease.error==msg && emitter.count(failed)==1

tests.title: The provider receives hub's spec, not the caller's
given: a lease recording image, network and resources, with 90 minutes left
a profile with fixed env, require_landlock and a resource field the lease lacks
tests.when: Create is called with caller spec image "evil", env {X:1}, network "host", TTL 99h, Workdir "/w"
then: provider spec Image, Network and Resources equal the lease's values
unrecorded resource fields and RequireLandlock come from the profile
Workdir is "/w"
TTL is a whole-second duration no greater than the remaining lease time
Env has no key X
tests.pseudocode: spec=prov.lastSpec; assert spec.Image==lease.Image && spec.Workdir=='/w' && spec.TTL%time.Second==0 && spec.TTL<=remaining && !has(spec.Env,'X')

tests.title: Labels drop caller hub.* keys, prefix lease labels and set hub.lease and hub.workspace last
given: a lease with label {team:x}, id L, workspace slug S
tests.when: Create is called with caller labels {a:1, hub.lease:forged}
then: the provider labels equal {a:1, hub.team:x, hub.lease:L, hub.workspace:S}
tests.pseudocode: assert prov.lastSpec.Labels == {'a':'1','hub.team':'x','hub.lease':L,'hub.workspace':S}

tests.title: Caller-controlled spec fields never influence the provider spec
given: a fixed leased lease and profile with a recording provider
tests.when: for any generated caller sandbox.Spec (random image, env, network, resources, TTL, landlock flag)
then: Image, Network, Resources, RequireLandlock and Env of the provider spec equal those produced for sandbox.Spec{} on a fresh equivalent lease
tests.pseudocode: base=specFor(Spec{}); for s in gen(): got=specFor(s); assert eq(got.Image,base.Image)&&eq(got.Env,base.Env)&&eq(got.Network,base.Network)&&eq(got.Resources,base.Resources)&&got.RequireLandlock==base.RequireLandlock

tests.title: Secrets resolve tier by tier at Create and a rotated value takes effect
given: a real secrets.Store on SQLite
a name stored in workspace and user scopes with different values
the workspace value changed after the lease was POSTed
tests.when: Create is called
then: the provider Env has the current workspace value, not the user value, and not the pre-rotation value
tests.pseudocode: store.Update(ws,K,'new'); Create(); assert prov.lastSpec.Env[K]=='new'

tests.title: The org tier is searched only when the owner is a member of the workspace's org
given: a real secrets.Store with a secret stored only at the org scope
a workspace with org_id set; two cases: owner is a member, owner is not
tests.when: Create is called in each case with a profile requiring that secret
then: member case: the secret is injected
non-member case: the secret is treated as missing and the lease fails with secret_missing
tests.pseudocode: assert Env[K]=='orgval' (member); assert failed && startsWith(error,'secret_missing:') (nonmember)

tests.title: A required secret found in no tier fails the lease naming the key and the scopes
given: a leased lease requiring GIT_PAT which is stored nowhere
a recording provider and emitter
tests.when: Create is called
then: FailedPrecondition with text starting "secret_missing:" naming GIT_PAT and the scope types workspace, org, user
the lease reads failed with the same error
exactly one hub.sandbox.failed event
provider Create count is 0
tests.pseudocode: assert startsWith(msg,'secret_missing:') && contains(msg,'GIT_PAT') && lease.error==msg && emitter.count(failed)==1 && prov.creates==0

tests.title: A missing optional secret is omitted and Create succeeds
given: a profile with an optional secret name stored nowhere
tests.when: Create is called
then: Create succeeds
the provider Env lacks that key
tests.pseudocode: assert err==nil && !has(prov.lastSpec.Env,'OPT')

tests.title: A store error leaves the lease leased with the claim released and retry proceeds
given: a secrets lookup that returns a generic error once, then works
tests.when: Create is called, then called again
then: the first returns gRPC Internal
the lease reads leased with error null
the second Create proceeds and succeeds
tests.pseudocode: assert code(err1)==Internal && lease.state=='leased' && lease.error==nil; assert err2==nil

tests.title: Env is the fixed env plus resolved secrets under the profile's spelling
given: profile secret GIT_PAT stored as git_pat with value V, and fixed env {A:1,B:2}
tests.when: Create is called
then: Env equals {A:1,B:2,GIT_PAT:V}
tests.pseudocode: assert prov.lastSpec.Env == {'A':'1','B':'2','GIT_PAT':V}

tests.title: No sandbox_leases column holds the planted secret value after Create
given: a real SQLite lease store and secrets store with a planted secret value
tests.when: Create succeeds and then fails (second lease)
then: dumping every column of every sandbox_leases row never contains the planted value
tests.pseudocode: rows=dumpAll('sandbox_leases'); assert !contains(rows, SECRET)

tests.title: A successful Create moves the lease to active with sandbox_id and emits one create event
given: a leased lease, a real SQLite store, a recording provider and emitter
tests.when: Create is called
then: a sandbox is returned
the lease reads active with sandbox_id equal to the box's ID()
exactly one hub.sandbox.create event with lease_id, sandbox_id, image and network
tests.pseudocode: sb=Create(); l=get(id); assert l.state=='active' && l.sandbox_id==sb.ID() && emitter.count(create)==1

tests.title: A DELETE during the provider Create destroys the new box and emits no create event
given: a provider whose Create blocks, during which the lease is moved leased → destroyed
captured slog output
tests.when: the provider Create is released
then: Create returns FailedPrecondition naming "destroyed"
the provider List no longer has the box
zero hub.sandbox.create events
a warning log carries the lease id and sandbox id
the lease stays destroyed
tests.pseudocode: assert code==FailedPrecondition && contains(msg,'destroyed') && len(prov.List())==0 && emitter.count(create)==0 && logs.has(WARN,leaseID,boxID)

tests.title: A provider Create error is scrubbed, stored on the lease, evented and returned
given: a provider whose Create fails with an error echoing a resolved secret and a URL with userinfo
tests.when: Create is called
then: the returned error text equals the scrubbed text
the lease reads failed with error equal to the scrubbed text
exactly one hub.sandbox.failed event with lease_id and an error field equal to the scrubbed text
the secret value appears in none of these
tests.pseudocode: want=scrub(raw); assert err.msg==want && lease.error==want && ev.Metadata.error==want

tests.title: State changes are conditional, set ended_at, clear the token hash on failure and never leave terminal states
given: leases in leased, destroyed and failed states
tests.when: each transition (leased→active, leased→failed, leased→destroyed, active→destroyed) is attempted with the right and with the wrong expected state, including from destroyed and failed
then: a wrong expected state updates zero rows
no update moves a lease out of destroyed or failed
ended_at is set on entering failed or destroyed
a failed lease's token lookup returns not found
tests.pseudocode: n=Transition(id,from,to); assert n==0 when state!=from; assert lookup(tokenOfFailed)==NotFound

tests.title: A second Create under the same token is refused: FailedPrecondition when active, Unauthenticated when terminal
given: a gatewayd.Server with hub's backend and authenticator, a counting provider, a real gateway.Dial client
tests.when: Create succeeds, a second Create is issued; then the lease is destroyed and a third Create is issued; on another lease a failed Create is followed by a second Create
then: second Create gets FailedPrecondition
after destroy or failure the next Create gets Unauthenticated
provider Create count stays 1 for the first lease
tests.pseudocode: assert code(c.Create())==FailedPrecondition; destroy(); assert code(c.Create())==Unauthenticated; assert prov.creates==1

tests.title: Concurrent Creates with at most one DELETE call the provider at most once and leave no live box on a destroyed lease
given: a leased lease and a recording provider with a randomised Create delay
tests.when: for any number of concurrent Create calls (1..8) under one token, interleaved at a random point with zero or one DELETE
then: provider Create count ≤ 1
if the lease ends destroyed the provider List has no live box for it
tests.pseudocode: for sched in gen(): run(sched); assert prov.creates<=1; if lease.state=='destroyed': assert len(prov.List())==0

tests.title: Capabilities narrows network modes to the intersection with network_modes
given: a provider offering [none, bridge, host]
network_modes [none, bridge]
tests.when: backend.Capabilities() is called
then: NetworkModes equals [none, bridge]
tests.pseudocode: assert eq(b.Capabilities().NetworkModes,['none','bridge'])

tests.title: List returns only the principal's box, or the provider's list without a principal
given: a provider holding three boxes
a principal whose lease is active with one of them, and a principal whose lease is leased
tests.when: List is called with each principal and with none
then: the active lease's principal gets exactly its box
the leased lease's principal gets an empty list
no principal gets all three boxes
tests.pseudocode: assert ids(List(ctxActive))==[box]; assert len(List(ctxLeased))==0; assert len(List(noPrincipal))==3

tests.title: Close through the gateway destroys the box, records client, and a provider not-found counts as success
given: a gatewayd.Server with hub's backend, an emitter, a recording provider
two active leases; for the second, the provider's Destroy returns the not-found sentinel
tests.when: each client calls Close on its sandbox
then: both calls return nil
for the first the provider List no longer has the box
both leases read destroyed with end_reason "client"
exactly one hub.sandbox.destroy event per lease with lease_id, sandbox_id and reason "client"
tests.pseudocode: assert sb.Close()==nil; l=get(id); assert l.state=='destroyed' && l.end_reason=='client' && emitter.count(destroy)==1

tests.title: Destroy of an id the principal's lease does not own is refused without touching the provider
given: an active lease with sandbox_id B1
tests.when: backend.Destroy("B2") is called with that principal
then: a not-found error is returned
provider Destroy count is 0
the lease is unchanged
tests.pseudocode: assert code(err)==NotFound && prov.destroys==0 && lease==before

tests.title: A non-not-found provider Destroy error on the client path returns the scrubbed error and leaves the lease active
given: a provider whose Destroy fails with an error echoing a secret value
tests.when: Close is called
then: the returned error text equals the scrubbed text without the secret
the lease reads active
zero hub.sandbox.destroy events
tests.pseudocode: assert err.msg==scrub(raw) && lease.state=='active' && emitter.count(destroy)==0

tests.title: Reap passes through and handle methods other than Spec and Close delegate unchanged
given: a recording provider and recording sandbox, and a handle returned by Create
tests.when: backend.Reap is called once and relayed handle methods (e.g. ID, Exec) are called with arguments
then: provider Reap is called once
the provider's sandbox receives each call with unchanged arguments
tests.pseudocode: b.Reap(ctx); assert prov.reaps==1; h.Exec(a); assert sb.lastExecArgs==a

tests.title: The handle's Spec() keeps Env keys but redacts every value
given: a Create with fixed env and resolved secrets
tests.when: handle.Spec() is called
then: Env has the same key set as the provider spec
every value equals "[redacted]"
other fields are as built
tests.pseudocode: s=h.Spec(); assert keys(s.Env)==keys(prov.lastSpec.Env) && all(v=='[redacted]'); assert s.Image==prov.lastSpec.Image

tests.title: DELETE of an active lease destroys the box, records api, evented once, and revokes the token
given: an active lease with a live box in a recording provider
lease routes with a real store and recording emitter, authorised caller
tests.when: DELETE /api/v1/workspaces/widgets/sandboxes/:id is called
then: HTTP 204
the provider Destroy was called under a context with a deadline ≤ 30s
GET one reads destroyed with end_reason "api"
a relayed RPC on the token answers Unauthenticated
exactly one hub.sandbox.destroy event with the box id, reason "api", ActorID and ActorType of the HTTP credential
tests.pseudocode: r=del(); assert r.status==204 && prov.destroyDeadline<=30s && get().end_reason=='api' && ev.Metadata.sandbox_id==boxID && ev.ActorType==auth.CredentialType

tests.title: DELETE treats a provider not-found as destroyed
given: an active lease whose box the provider reports as not found on Destroy
tests.when: DELETE is called
then: HTTP 204
the lease reads destroyed with end_reason "api"
tests.pseudocode: assert status==204 && lease.end_reason=='api'

tests.title: A provider Destroy failure or timeout on DELETE answers 502 sandbox_provider_error and changes nothing
given: an active lease
a provider whose Destroy first fails with an error echoing a secret, then blocks past the deadline (injected short deadline), then succeeds
tests.when: DELETE is called three times
then: the first two answer 502 with error_type "sandbox_provider_error" and scrubbed message
the lease reads active and the token still authenticates after each
no hub.sandbox.destroy event after the failures
the third DELETE answers 204
tests.pseudocode: assert r.status==502 && r.body.error_type=='sandbox_provider_error' && !contains(r.body,SECRET) && lease.state=='active'; later assert del().status==204

tests.title: DELETE of a leased lease destroys it without calling the provider and emits one event with null sandbox_id
given: a leased lease and a recording provider and emitter
tests.when: DELETE is called
then: HTTP 204
provider Destroy count is 0
GET one reads destroyed with end_reason "api"
one hub.sandbox.destroy event with sandbox_id null and reason "api"
a later Create under the token is refused with Unauthenticated
tests.pseudocode: assert status==204 && prov.destroys==0 && ev.Metadata.sandbox_id==nil && ev.count==1

tests.title: A state change between DELETE's read and update is re-read once and the box is destroyed
given: a lease that is leased when DELETE reads it and becomes active (box created) before DELETE's conditional update
tests.when: DELETE continues
then: HTTP 204
the box is gone from the provider's List
the lease ends destroyed
exactly one destroy event
tests.pseudocode: hook after read: createBox(); r=del(); assert r.status==204 && len(prov.List())==0 && lease.state=='destroyed' && ev.count==1

tests.title: DELETE of a terminal lease keeps spec 26's behaviour with no provider call or event
given: leases in destroyed, expired and failed states
tests.when: DELETE is called for each
then: each answers HTTP 204
provider Destroy count is 0
zero hub.sandbox.destroy events
tests.pseudocode: for l in terminals: assert del(l).status==204; assert prov.destroys==0 && ev.count==0

tests.title: Scrub replaces values, removes URL userinfo, then truncates
given: secret value "s3cret"
fixed env value "envval"
tests.when: scrub is applied to "pull https://u:tok@reg failed: -e K=s3cret" and to a text containing envval
then: the first becomes "pull https://reg failed: -e K=[redacted]"
envval becomes [redacted]
empty values are ignored (no change from an empty string value)
a 5000-byte text is cut to ≤1024 bytes
tests.pseudocode: assert scrub(in,['s3cret'])=='pull https://reg failed: -e K=[redacted]'; assert scrub(x,[''])==x

tests.title: Scrub output is valid UTF-8, at most 1024 bytes, and contains no value
given: generated non-empty values
tests.when: for any text (including values placed across the 1024-byte boundary and multi-byte runes at the cut) and any set of non-empty values
then: the output is valid UTF-8
len(output) ≤ 1024
no value is a substring of the output
tests.pseudocode: for t,vals in gen(): o=scrub(t,vals); assert utf8.Valid(o) && len(o)<=1024; for v in vals: assert !contains(o,v)

tests.title: A planted secret never appears in any HTTP body, event, log, gateway error, lease error or handle Spec
given: a planted secret value and a fixed env value
a provider whose Create and Destroy errors contain the values
captured slog, recording emitter, HTTP body collection, a real gateway.Dial client
tests.when: leases are driven through POST, a failing Create, a successful Create with Spec(), Close, and a failing then successful DELETE
then: the planted value and env value are a substring of none of: HTTP bodies, audit events (all fields and metadata), log lines, gRPC error messages, lease error fields, handle Spec() output
no lease token or token hash appears in the logs
tests.pseudocode: outputs=collect(); for o in outputs: assert !contains(o,SECRET) && !contains(o,ENVVAL) && !contains(logs,token)

tests.title: The three events carry the correct actor, workspace, resource and secret names only
given: a recording emitter and one lease driven through create, failed (second lease) and gateway destroy, and an HTTP DELETE
tests.when: the events are inspected
then: each has Workspace equal to the lease slug, ResourceType "sandbox", ResourceID the lease id
gateway-raised events have ActorType "lease" and ActorID the lease's created_by
no metadata value equals a secret or env value

tests.title: A nil or failing emitter changes no outcome
